label: D27-hapus-kartu-ditangguhkan
decision: Should a card owner be able to delete a SUSPENDED card (FR-31), and when may the app delete a card locally without server confirmation?

candidates.description: Challenge allowed for ACTIVE or SUSPENDED credentials (renewal still requires ACTIVE); DELETE accepts ACTIVE or SUSPENDED cards and revokes them; distinct 410 CARD-GONE only for cards already REVOKED/DELETED or unknown; the app deletes locally without confirmation only on that code and tries each credential first.
Keep deletion ACTIVE-only; suspended cards show 'contact the building' and stay.
Current behavior: app deletes locally on 409; the server card stays SUSPENDED and keeps its slot.

priorities: 1) FR-31: deleting revokes on the server and frees the slot. 2) Never leave a server credential that could be resumed without its key. 3) Delete locally without confirmation only when the server says the card is gone. 4) Simple, consistent with ADR-0026.
requirements: Deleting a suspended card revokes it on the server and frees the device's card slot.
The app deletes a card locally without server confirmation only when the server reports the card as already revoked or unknown.
No resumed card can reactivate a credential whose key the user deleted.
